description: Notification (docs.joinmastodon.org/entities/Notification). Mastodon defines new types over time and asks clients to ignore what they do not know; this app's own types are namespaced, except Pixelfed's `tagged`.

anyOf.description: an extension type, namespaced the way Pleroma and Pixelfed namespace theirs (bluesky:verified, story:react)
Pixelfed's own name for a photo tag, which its app reads; a deliberate deviation
